check_modules_have_similar_state_dict: check if two PyTorch nn.Module instances have approximately the same state_dict using configurable tolerances
check_optimizers_have_similar_state_dict: check if two PyTorch optimizers have approximately the same state_dict and return a difference description
compare_state_dict_owners: compare two state dict owners (modules, optimizers, or dicts) for approximate equality with tolerance
test_modules_have_similar_state_dict: test the modules_have_similar_state_dict function by comparing two nn.Module instances and verifying the returned difference string
refactor_state_dict_owners_have_similar_: refactor the state_dict_owners_have_similar_state_dict function to support additional state dict owner types beyond modules and optimizers
